spec.name: nats
spec.code:
/-- A byte string as numbers. -/
def nats (v : List U8) : List Nat := v.map (·.val)

spec.name: parseI64Spec
spec.code:
/-- `str::parse::<i64>()`: an optional `+` or `-`, then digits, in range. -/
def parseI64Spec (s : List Nat) : Option Int :=
  let (neg, ds) := match s with
    | 45 :: r => (true, r)
    | 43 :: r => (false, r)
    | r => (false, r)
  match digitsVal ds with
  | none => none
  | some v =>
    let x : Int := if neg then -(v : Int) else v
    if -(2 ^ 63 : Int) ≤ x ∧ x < 2 ^ 63 then some x else none

spec.name: digitsVal
spec.code:
/-- The decimal value of a nonempty digit string. -/
def digitsVal : List Nat → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | ds => if ds.all (fun d => 48 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 57) then some (ds.foldl (fun acc d => 10 * acc + (d - 48)) 0) else none

/-- [rustfs_kernel::bytes::parse_i64]:
    Source: 'src/bytes.rs', lines 149:0-159:1
    Visibility: public -/
def bytes.parse_i64 (s : Slice Std.U8) : Result (Option Std.I64) := do
  let i := Slice.len s
  if i = 0#usize
  then ok none
  else
    let i1 ← Slice.index_usize s 0#usize
    let start ←
      if i1 = 45#u8
      then ok 1#usize
      else if i1 = 43#u8
           then ok 1#usize
           else ok 0#usize
    let i2 := Slice.len s
    if start = i2
    then ok none
    else bytes.parse_digits s start 0#i64 (i1 = 45#u8)

/-- [rustfs_kernel::bytes::parse_digits]:
    Source: 'src/bytes.rs', lines 128:0-146:1 -/
def bytes.parse_digits
  (s : Slice Std.U8) (i : Std.Usize) (acc : Std.I64) (neg : Bool) :
  Result (Option Std.I64)
  := do
  let i1 := Slice.len s
  if i >= i1
  then ok (some acc)
  else
    let c ← Slice.index_usize s i
    if c < 48#u8
    then ok none
    else
      if c > 57#u8
      then ok none
      else
        let i2 ← c - 48#u8
        let d ← lift (UScalar.hcast .I64 i2)
        let o ← lift (I64.checked_mul acc 10#i64)
        match o with
        | none => ok none
        | some m =>
          let next ←
            if neg
            then ok (I64.checked_sub m d)
            else ok (I64.checked_add m d)
          match next with
          | none => ok none
          | some v => let i3 ← i + 1#usize
                      bytes.parse_digits s i3 v neg
